name: Motu
description: A gamified 3D fitness tracking app. Exercise on a tropical island, earn gold, and customize your avatar with AI-powered movement tracking.
authMode: Falls back to Local Guest Mode (localStorage) when Firebase is unconfigured.

optionalCredentials.GEMINI_API_KEY: Enables POST /api/shop/chat (the AI shop assistant). Without it that one endpoint returns 500; everything else works.
optionalCredentials.firebase-applet-config.json: Replace placeholders to persist to a real Firestore instead of localStorage.

files.role: Firebase client config. Sanitized to placeholders in this bundle so the app boots straight into Local Guest Mode.
Deployed Firestore security rules. DRAFT_firestore.rules is a work-in-progress variant, not what is live.
Vite HTML entry. Mounts #root and loads src/main.tsx.
AI Studio applet manifest: display name, requested camera permission, server-side Gemini capability flag.
Express host. In dev it wraps Vite as middleware on port 3000; in prod it serves dist/. Also owns POST /api/shop/chat, the Gemini-backed shop assistant.
Top-level view router and persistent HUD chrome. Chooses between Scene and the full-screen views (Shop, Fitness, Tracker, Dressing Room, Building Interior).
Player character: procedural mesh plus the movement/animation state machine (walk, run, several swim poses, hammock, emotes).
Camera. First/third-person blending, collision, and the free-fly build-mode rig.
Instanced fish schools circling the island shallows.
Ocean surface: custom GLSL wave displacement, shoreline foam, depth tinting.
The R3F Canvas and scene graph root: lighting, island, ocean, sky, weather, and every 3D actor.
Input-to-motion math shared by the avatar: acceleration, terrain and water height sampling, collision.
Layout primitive that assigns HUD elements to the shared safe-area regions.
Canvas-drawn minimap. Reads live position from playerBus (or the build-mode camera when that is active).
Single source of truth for ocean surface / swim body world-Y. Ocean, Avatar, Weather and Fish must all read these, never re-literal them.
Global state: profile, inventory, equipped items, current view, UI flags. Backed by Firestore or localStorage depending on auth mode.
Tailwind entry AND the authoritative GLOBAL Z-INDEX LAYER SYSTEM. Read the comment block at the top before positioning anything.

Firebase wrapper AND a full localStorage-backed Firestore shim. When the config is a placeholder or anonymous auth fails, the app transparently runs in Local Guest Mode - this is why it boots with no credentials.
Non-React per-frame state bus between the 3D layer and HUD overlays, plus clampFrameDelta() - the tab-resume delta guard that stops the camera spinning after a tab switch.
All audio. Every effect is synthesized live with the Web Audio API (no sound files at all), including the layered swim ambience.
React root. Wraps <App/> in an ErrorBoundary that renders the error + component stack on screen instead of a blank page.
Shared domain types: UserProfile, ShopItem, PlacedItem, WorkoutLog, View enum, ItemCategory.
Vite config. Note the usePolling watcher (the repo lives on OneDrive, where native FS events are unreliable) and the manual vendor chunk split.
